# EC P-256 certificates for critical-extension and end-entity-role tests. Validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31, all
# ecdsa-with-SHA256. root_cert is self-signed (serial 1). inter_serverauth_cert and inter_clientauth_cert share
# one subject name and key (CN=TlsLib Critical Ext Issuer, CA:TRUE) and differ only in a CRITICAL extendedKeyUsage:
# serverAuth+clientAuth, and clientAuth only. leaf_cert (CN/SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth) is issued by that key.
# mustaple_leaf_cert is issued by root_cert with a CRITICAL TLS Feature extension (status_request, RFC 7633).
# caleaf_cert is a CA:TRUE certificate with SAN=localhost and EKU serverAuth issued by root_cert (a sub-CA
# served as an end-entity certificate). selfca_cert is a self-signed CA:TRUE certificate with SAN=localhost, the
# shape openssl req -x509 emits, for pinning as its own anchor.
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.2.1 (openssl ca -startdate 20200101000000Z -enddate 20991231000000Z; a fresh P-256 key per
# certificate except the two intermediates, extension files as described above; tlsfeature=critical,status_request).
# ring_00..ring_07 are eight self-signed certificates sharing one subject (CN=TlsLib Ring X) and one key, serials
# 200..207; ring_leaf (CN=localhost) is issued by that key. Each ring certificate is a valid issuer of the leaf and of
# the others, for the issuer-line cost bound (openssl x509 -req -signkey / -CA, ecdsa-with-SHA256, -days 30000).
root_
inter_serverauth_
inter_clientauth_
leaf_
mustaple_leaf_
caleaf_
selfca_
# More leaves issued by root_cert for the TLS Feature rules (SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth, TLS Feature critical):
# mustaple_v2_leaf_cert lists status_request and status_request_v2; other_feature_leaf_cert lists only status_request_v2.
# feature_inter_cert is a CA issued by root_cert with a critical status_request TLS Feature; feature_inter_leaf_cert is a plain leaf under it.
# Distrust classification: x_leaf_cert is issued by an unrelated CA (not supplied); i2_cert and w1_cert are CAs issued by the key of
# inter_serverauth_cert; w1_leaf_cert is a leaf issued by w1_cert, so w1_leaf_cert <- w1_cert <- inter_serverauth_cert <- root_cert.
mustaple_v2_leaf_
other_feature_leaf_
feature_inter_
feature_inter_leaf_
